description: This file defines user settings management for a web application, including enums, a class for getting/setting preferences, and functions for exporting/importing settings.

classes.name: UserSettings
classes.description: A class providing static methods to get, set, and manage user preferences stored in localStorage, including handling JSON data and specific settings like language, theme, last viewed IDs, and emoji settings.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve a user setting value by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Set a user setting value by key, with change notification.

methods.name: get language
methods.description: Get the preferred language setting.

methods.name: set language
methods.description: Set the preferred language.

methods.name: get theme
methods.description: Get the theme setting.

methods.name: set theme
methods.description: Set the theme.

methods.name: get lastTeamId
methods.description: Get the last selected team ID.

methods.name: set lastTeamId
methods.description: Set the last selected team ID.

methods.name: get lastBoardId
methods.description: Get a mapping of team IDs to last selected board IDs.

methods.name: setLastTeamID
methods.description: Update last team ID.

methods.name: setLastBoardID
methods.description: Update last board ID for a team.

methods.name: get lastViewId
methods.description: Get a mapping of board IDs to last viewed view IDs.

methods.name: setLastViewId
methods.description: Update last view ID for a board.

methods.name: get prefillRandomIcons
methods.description: Check if random icons should be prefilled.

methods.name: set prefillRandomIcons
methods.description: Set whether to prefill random icons.

methods.name: getEmojiMartSetting
methods.description: Retrieve an emoji-mart related setting.

methods.name: setEmojiMartSetting
methods.description: Set an emoji-mart related setting.

methods.name: get mobileWarningClosed
methods.description: Check if mobile warning has been closed.

methods.name: set mobileWarningClosed
methods.description: Mark mobile warning as closed.

methods.name: get nameFormat
methods.description: Get the name format setting.

methods.name: set nameFormat
methods.description: Set the name format.
